sources.title: Gemma 4 Abliteration - GitHub
sources.snippet: Unified model (12B): Same dense biprojection on the text decoder. gemma-4-12B-it is the encoder-free Gemma4Unified arch (added 2026-06-03); its refusal signal sits in the upper layers (L15-47), so only the top 70% are abliterated.
